# Clip

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Each feature cut by a mask (the union of its features): the part inside, as turf.intersect and a clip do, or the part outside, as turf.difference does. Features left with nothing are dropped. turf takes the first feature of each side; this cuts every feature by the whole mask.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "clip", "name": "clip", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
| `mask` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

<!-- gen:begin params -->
